propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key; only full-text searches title, description, tags, and comment bodies
the _haystack function excludes every identifier field a user is likely to paste (ticket_id, alias, jira_key), and the binding store Jira keys are never enriched into reduced state
search should accept the same identifiers as show command (e.g. 'rebar search REB-1654' should resolve like 'rebar show REB-1654')
identifier matching must be case-insensitive so 'search REB-1654' and 'search reb-1654' both surface the bound ticket

the fix must keep search_states pure and defer identifier enrichment to the caller search_state, which builds the ticket_id→jira_key map once from the binding store and annotates states before calling search_states
